claims: Artemis II mission launches from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida
Artemis II mission carries four astronauts
Artemis II mission is a 10-day trip around the moon
Artemis II mission uses Space Launch System (SLS) rocket
Artemis II mission uses Orion spacecraft
Artemis II is the first crewed Artemis mission
Launch Complex 39B was previously used for Apollo missions
Launch Complex 39B was previously used for Skylab missions
Launch Complex 39B was previously used for Space Shuttle missions
